title.zh: 美国拦截三艘伊朗油轮；油价飙升突破 94 美元，股市下滑
title.en: U.S. intercepts three Iranian tankers; oil surges above $94, stocks slip

summary.en: U.S. stocks slip as Iran tensions escalate with US interception of three oil tankers, pushing Brent above $94/barrel. Tesla's muted AI progress underperforms, while elevated oil prices weigh on growth stocks and inflate inflation expectations. Geopolitical risk premium dominates the session, forcing a risk-off tilt despite prior gains.
summary.zh: 美国拦截三艘油轮后，与伊朗的紧张局势升级，美股下跌，布伦特原油突破每桶 94 美元。特斯拉 AI 业务进展乏善可陈，高油价拖累成长股，并推升通胀预期。尽管此前市场上涨，地缘政治风险溢价仍在这场交易中占主导，市场避险情绪升温。

title.zh: Google 在新财报前推出新 TPU 挑战 Nvidia AI 芯片主导地位
title.en: Google challenges NVIDIA's AI chip dominance with new TPUs ahead of earnings

summary.en: Stock futures point to mixed open as AI sector rally continues amid Google TPU launch and TSMC earnings momentum. Geopolitical risk premium remains embedded in oil prices despite Hormuz opening. 10Y yields stabilize near 4.27%.
summary.zh: 股指期货显示美股可能涨跌互现开盘，AI 板块在 Google TPU 发布和台积电财报带动下继续反弹。尽管霍尔木兹开放，油价仍包含地缘政治风险溢价。10 年期美债收益率稳定在 4.27% 附近。

title.zh: 伊朗宣布霍尔木兹海峡对航运开放，同时美国封锁仍有效
title.en: Iran declares Strait of Hormuz open to shipping as U.S. blockade remains active

summary.en: Futures point to a higher open as markets assess progress in Middle East peace talks. Iran declares Strait of Hormuz open to shipping, easing geopolitical tensions and potentially supporting oil prices. The rally extends hopes for broader de-escalation in the region.
summary.zh: 期货指向更高开盘，市场评估中东和平会谈进展。伊朗宣布霍尔木兹海峡对航运开放，缓解地缘紧张局势，可能支撑油价。市场希望该地区缓和的局势扩大。

title.zh: 中东外交突破 + AI 财报推动标普 500 和纳指创历史新高
title.en: Middle East diplomatic breakthrough + AI earnings drive S&P 500 and Nasdaq to new highs

summary.en: US stocks opened higher driven by Middle East de-escalation hopes and AI earnings momentum, with S&P 500 and Nasdaq hitting new highs. Strong semiconductor earnings and AI super-cycle optimism boosted tech leadership.
summary.zh: 美股在中东局势有望缓和及 AI 相关公司的强劲业绩 推动下高开走强，标普 500 和纳指创下历史新高。半导体强劲财报与 AI 超级周期乐观情绪带动科技股领涨。

title.zh: 市场下调霍尔木兹海峡短期风险定价，油价回落延续
title.en: Oil Pullback Extends as Markets Price Lower Immediate Hormuz Risk

summary.en: Markets open with a constructive but cautious tone after Tuesday's relief rally. Oil has cooled from the Hormuz scare, helping Treasury yields stabilize and supporting growth assets, but the tape is still highly headline-sensitive. The setup favors quality tech, semis, and selective duration if energy stays contained, while traders remain alert to renewed geopolitical or inflation shocks.
summary.zh: 美股周三开盘前整体情绪偏建设性，但仍然谨慎。此前因霍尔木兹风险引发的油价冲击有所缓和，带动美债收益率趋稳，并继续支持成长资产表现。不过，市场依然高度受新闻标题驱动。如果能源价格继续受控，优质科技、半导体和部分久期资产仍占优，但交易者仍需警惕地缘政治或通胀风险再次升温。

title.zh: 中国谴责美国封锁霍尔木兹海峡，油价回落至100美元下方
title.en: China Condemns U.S. Hormuz Blockade, Oil Retreats Below $100

summary.en: Markets trade higher as Middle East geopolitics pivots toward de-escalation hopes, with U.S.-Iran talks continuing and oil retreating below $100. Treasury yields edge lower on calmer oil, while cyber-security concerns from Jamie Dimon's Mythos warning add nuanced risk to tech. The rally reflects relief that Hormuz disruption may ease, though fuel supply risks in Europe remain unresolved.
summary.zh: 市场整体走强，中东局势从升级交易转向缓和预期，美伊接触继续，油价回落至100美元下方。随着油价降温，10年期美债收益率小幅回落，但 Jamie Dimon 对 Anthropic Mythos 暴露网络安全脆弱性的警告，又给科技板块增加了一层风险。当前反弹本质上是对霍尔木兹风险暂时缓和的 relief rally，不过欧洲燃料供应隐忧仍未消失。

title.zh: 美伊和平会谈崩溃后美国封锁伊朗港口，油价跳涨 6%
title.en: U.S.-Iran Peace Talks Collapse After U.S. Naval Blockade of Iranian Ports, Oil Prices Surge 6%

summary.en: Markets mixed on Monday as US-Iran peace talks collapsed and Strait of Hormuz blockade sparked oil volatility: Dow -0.6%, S&P -0.3%, Nasdaq -0.4%. Oil briefly surged above $100 before easing. Tech underperformed as geopolitical risk premium elevated, while energy producers benefited. 10Y Treasury yields stable at 4.29% despite oil spike. Investors weighing recession risks from energy inflation versus earnings quality support.
summary.zh: 美股周一受挫：美伊和平会谈破裂，霍尔木兹海峡封锁引发油价波动：道指 -0.6%、标普 -0.3%、纳指 -0.4%。WTI 跳涨突破 100 美元后回落。科技股受地缘政治压制，能源板块受益。10Y 美债收益率稳定在 4.29%。投资者权衡能源通胀引发的衰退风险与财报质量的支撑。

title.zh: 通胀数据偏热，市场重新强化“更高更久”的利率定价
title.en: Hot inflation print keeps 'higher for longer' back in the market

summary.en: Markets stayed mixed under the same macro headline: energy-driven inflation pressure. Oil remained elevated enough to keep 'higher for longer' rate fears alive, which capped broad risk appetite, but Nasdaq still showed relative resilience as investors kept rotating toward higher-quality growth instead of fully abandoning tech.
summary.zh: 今天市场依然被同一条宏观主线牵着走：能源推动的通胀压力。油价仍处高位，足以让市场继续交易“利率更高、更久”，压制广义风险偏好；但纳指仍表现出相对韧性，说明资金不是完全撤出科技，而是在往更高质量的成长资产收缩。

title.zh: 油价走高、停火叙事变脆弱，美股整体转为小幅回落
title.en: U.S. stocks slip as traders digest higher oil and a more fragile ceasefire backdrop

summary.en: U.S. equities opened with a cautious, slightly risk-off tone as oil surged and Treasury yields stayed elevated, offsetting some of the relief from the recent U.S.-Iran ceasefire narrative. The S&P 500, Nasdaq, and Dow were all modestly lower, which suggests the market is no longer blindly chasing yesterday's rebound and is instead re-pricing inflation, energy, and headline fragility together.
summary.zh: 美股今天开盘时基调偏谨慎、略偏 偏向避险：油价大涨、长端美债收益率维持高位，抵消了此前美伊停火叙事带来的部分缓和情绪。标普、纳指和道指都小幅回落，说明市场已经不再继续追涨，而是在同时重新定价通胀、能源和 消息面风险。

title.zh: 停火预期推动美股大涨，市场出现全面缓和式反弹
title.en: U.S. stocks rip higher as ceasefire hopes trigger a broad relief rally

summary.en: U.S. equities staged a sharp relief rally as markets leaned into a fragile U.S.-Iran ceasefire narrative, pushing the S&P 500 up about 2.5%, the Nasdaq up about 2.8%, and the Dow up about 2.9%. The tone flipped risk-on, led by technology and duration-sensitive assets, but the whole move still rests on whether Middle East de-escalation holds and whether oil avoids a renewed spike.
summary.zh: 美股今天走出明显的缓和式反弹：市场重新押注美伊停火叙事，标普约涨 2.5%、纳指约涨 2.8%、道指约涨 2.9%。整体情绪转向 风险偏好回升，科技和长久期资产领涨，但这波行情的根基仍取决于中东局势是否真的持续降温，以及油价会不会再次急冲。

title.zh: 中东出现停火窗口，全球市场暂时松一口气
title.en: Middle East ceasefire window gives global markets room to breathe

summary.en: Markets turned cautiously risk-on as a two-week Middle East ceasefire window eased immediate Strait of Hormuz fears. U.S. equities were mixed-to-slightly higher, 10Y Treasury yields fell to about 4.24%, and oil backed off from panic highs, but the macro tape remained hostage to geopolitical headlines and energy pass-through risk.
summary.zh: 市场重新偏向谨慎 风险偏好回升：中东出现两周停火窗口，市场对霍尔木兹海峡风险的短期恐慌缓解。美股主要指数小幅分化偏强，10 年期美债收益率回落至约 4.24%，油价也从恐慌高位回落，但宏观主线仍然被地缘政治和能源传导风险主导。
